contract.bucketRelaxation: QZ and ZQ may be occupied; audit and report both flags explicitly
contract.selection: One new initial mapping per trial; proxies prioritize motor/collision and initial home-row share, with deterministic diversified selection every third trial. Each trial gives its own initial map 32 legal final probes; continue only if the current target CKT improves by at least .003 in that batch, at most three batches. No full-neighborhood/global optimality claim.

selectionImplementationClarification: Candidate generation includes frequency-guided home-row allocations. Numeric ranking uses motor proxy plus weighted collision miss only; there is no explicit initial-home-share term. This clarifies the broader wording in the frozen raw contract description.

independentMemory.formula: M = ordinary_displacement_links + retroflex_links + YW_nonidentity_links + AEO_carriers + nonidentity_final_links + initial_extra_routes + final_extra_routes
independentMemory.scope: common399; normalized written tails with j/q/x/Y-u restored as v; er explicit; iu/ui/un retained
independentMemory.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once. Every additional key within a head/final costs one routing item. Optional aliases included only where authoritative source is supplied.

scope: Eighteen different initial maps with short final-probe batches. Switch when batch target improvement is below .003; at most three 32-layout batches per initial. Proxies plus deterministic diversification select candidates. Separate strict and temporarily relaxed QZ/ZQ domains. No exhaustive final neighborhood, initial neighborhood, local/global optimality, or robust auxiliary-policy claim. Full point-optimal auxiliary enumeration covers selected leaders only.
